findings.summary: Frontend still projects selected bank intake into cells before apply-items. Java validates/calculates after receipt, but future hardening should reduce apply-items to importLineId + manualFields.
Legacy Firestore write branches remain for disabled platform API/dev harness paths. Stage/live direct Java env gate must stay mandatory.
